test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). src/lib/use-file-download/import-meta-url.spec.ts reads the BUILT bundles at {projectRoot}/dist (index.js/index.umd.js/index.mjs) to prove the browser-embedding contract — a source-level test would pass while the shipped CJS/UMD artifact is broken. targetDefaults.test's `^build` builds only DEPENDENCIES, never this project's OWN dist, so an explicit `build` is declared. `lint`/`^build` are repeated because an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault (same shape as agent-engine-compiler). Without this the spec asserts against whatever stale dist/ happens to be on disk: after the Vite 6→8 upgrade a leftover Vite-6/Rollup artifact carried `pathToFileURL(__filename)` and reded the gate, even though Vite 8 + importMetaUrlBrowserCjs emits a browser-only shim.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/ui-react-base-hooks.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.
